name: dashsidian
description: Describe a dashboard, and your AI agent builds it in your note. Charts, habit streaks, heatmaps and goals from note properties, in YAML you can edit. No JavaScript, no Dataview, works on your phone.
author: Dmitriy Yurkin (Dimagious)

scripts.release:check: node scripts/version-sync.cjs && npm run scorecard:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm run release:zip
scripts.capture: npm run build && node scripts/demo-vault.cjs && CAPTURE=1 playwright test e2e/capture.spec.ts --reporter=list && opdk demo && node scripts/agent-hero.cjs
scripts.film:phone: npm run build && node scripts/demo-vault.cjs && FILM=1 playwright test e2e/film-phone.spec.ts --reporter=list && opdk demo film-phone film-phone-dark
scripts.firstrun: npm run build && node scripts/newcomer-vault.cjs && FIRSTRUN=1 OPDK_E2E_VAULT=.capture/newcomer playwright test e2e/firstrun.spec.ts --reporter=list
